intent: Climb from meadow through a wooded rise to cliffs and a broad overlook, then descend into a new valley. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

sections.name: The low meadow
sections.lesson: Follow the trail towards the wooded rise. Follow the weight as it swings away.

signs.text:
The low meadow
Follow the weight as it swings away.

sections.name: The wooded rise
sections.lesson: Rise through the shaded tree terraces. Follow the weight as it swings away.

signs.text:
The wooded rise
Follow the weight as it swings away.

sections.name: The cliff terraces
sections.lesson: Reverse around the cliff and climb to its top. Follow the weight as it swings away.

signs.text:
The cliff terraces
Follow the weight as it swings away.

sections.name: The meadow overlook
sections.lesson: The whole valley lies beneath the broad terrace. Follow the weight as it swings away.

signs.text:
The meadow overlook
Follow the weight as it swings away.

sections.name: Into the new valley
sections.lesson: Follow the far side into a different landscape. Follow the weight as it swings away.

signs.text:
Into the new valley
Follow the weight as it swings away.
